headline: India Weighs Export Duty and Floor Prices on Non-Basmati Rice Shipments
summary: India is considering a 30% export duty and minimum export price on non-Basmati rice to cool domestic inflation, while reserving a complete export ban as a last resort.
why: India is the world's largest rice exporter; trade interventions directly affect international grain benchmarks and food inflation across importing developing nations.

impacts.name: Rough Rice
impacts.why: Proposed Indian export tariffs constrain global supply availability, lifting international prices.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: Potential supply restrictions from the largest exporter drive global agricultural commodity prices higher.
